linkedin:
Only 22% of remote job listings on Loker Dollar disclose any pay — yet the ones that do show brand designers earning $3,000–$5,000 per fixed project.

Two live brand-identity roles set the range: Stevens pays $3,000–$5,000 per project (B2B SaaS logistics), and Sidekicks Creative Studio pays $1,500–$3,000 for street-food brand work. Across all 3,940 active listings, just 853 (22%) publish a rate; 64% are open to worldwide applicants.

The numbers carry a caveat. Only the minority that disclose pay are counted, and higher fixed sums aren't always better — a $1,500–$3,000 contract can mean steadier cash flow than a short, high-pressure $5,000 sprint.

For Indonesian designers chasing USD remote work, the practical move is to target the listings that actually publish rates. Full data and next steps here:
https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/remote-brand-designer-salary-trends-2026
